target: tracker.sh reconcile-done — merged branch advances to done, unmerged is untouched
cmd:
mkdir -p factory/specs; git init -q .; git -c user.email=t@test -c user.name=test commit -q --allow-empty -m init; git checkout -qb claude/idea-merged; git -c user.email=t@test -c user.name=test commit -q --allow-empty -m work-a; git checkout -q -; git merge -q --no-edit claude/idea-merged; git checkout -qb claude/idea-open; git -c user.email=t@test -c user.name=test commit -q --allow-empty -m work-b; git checkout -q -; printf -- '---
id: 001
title: merged one
status: pr-open
branch: claude/idea-merged
pr: local
---
' > factory/specs/001-a.md; printf -- '---
id: 002
title: open one
status: pr-open
branch: claude/idea-open
pr: local
---
' > factory/specs/002-b.md; "$PLUGIN_ROOT/scripts/lib/tracker.sh" reconcile-done tester >/dev/null; source "$PLUGIN_ROOT/scripts/lib/tracker.sh"; jq -n --arg s1 "$(_tracker_field factory/specs/001-a.md status)" --arg d1 "$(_tracker_field factory/specs/001-a.md done_at)" --arg s2 "$(_tracker_field factory/specs/002-b.md status)" --arg d2 "$(_tracker_field factory/specs/002-b.md done_at)" '{s1: $s1, d1: $d1, s2: $s2, d2: $d2}'
